conventions: bpp = Mbps*1e6/(W*H*fps). For tables Sony labels '23.98/24.0p' the bpp is computed at 24.0 (Sony gives the same Mbps for both); XAVC values listed as 23.98p use 23.976. For codecs where Sony's Mbps differs by imager mode in ways that are not proportional to pixels (derived modes reuse the parent readout rate), use codec.rates[] (per mode) over the single bpp. 'external' on a codec means it is not recorded in the camera body.
